scope_note: Level 1 (source) and Level 2 (isolated local) only. Level 3 (live production / real Microsoft tenant) was BLOCKED: AWS STS rejects the session credentials (InvalidClientTokenId); api.accessproof.in, app.accessproof.in and graph.microsoft.com are denied by the session network policy.

status_values.FIXED_LOCAL: fix committed and verified by tests in the isolated environment; NOT deployed
status_values.FIXED_REHEARSAL: fix committed and additionally verified through the real release scripts on a production-shaped stand-in; NOT deployed
status_values.BLOCKED: cannot be tested from this environment

findings.title: Runtime DB role was the PostgreSQL superuser; RLS bypassed
findings.reproduction: API connected as superuser+owner; 19/58 tenant tables had no policy; none forced
findings.fix: 3 NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS roles; FORCE RLS on 58 tables; switch script
regression_tests: full suite on PostgreSQL as accessproof_app

findings.title: After least-privilege switch every later migration would run without DDL rights
findings.reproduction: accessproof_app: 'must be owner of table organizations'

findings.title: Re-running switch rotated passwords; failure restore locked API out while reporting success
findings.reproduction: forced post-switch failure -> password authentication failed for accessproof_app; log said RESTORE complete

findings.title: Post-login open redirect via control characters in next=
findings.fix: reject control chars/whitespace/backslash; require same-origin resolution
regression_tests: web-v2/e2e/post-auth-redirect.spec.ts (fails on old build, passes on fix)

findings.title: Unknown-kid tokens forced one IdP JWKS fetch per request (amplification / throttling)
findings.fix: 30 s floor on forced refresh; rotation still honoured

findings.title: TOTP code replay opened a second session
Known-vulnerable dependencies (starlette Host/path URL reconstruction, cryptography bundled OpenSSL, opentelemetry tracestate ReDoS, certifi compromised CA, pillow, dnspython)
findings.fix: fastapi 0.162 / starlette 1.10 / cryptography 50.0.2 / certifi 2026.10.23 / pillow 13 / dnspython 2.9.1 / opentelemetry 1.45.2; pip-audit clean

findings.title: 16 moderate npm advisories in dev-only tooling
findings.fix: not shipped to users; upgrade with tooling refresh

expired, wrong tenant/audience/issuer, v1 issuer, Graph token, forged signature, unknown kid, nbf, missing exp/oid, alg=none, HS256 key confusion
attacks_that_held.result: all rejected with specific codes; only oid/sub accepted as subject

attacks_that_held.attack: reset-token reuse, invitation reuse / wrong email, VIEWER/AUDITOR/ENGINEER escalation, ADMIN ownership seizure, API key after downgrade, cookie CSRF
X-Forwarded-For spoofing through nginx to uvicorn 0.35
attacks_that_held.result: right-most untrusted hop used; spoofed entries ignored

attacks_that_held.result: HTTPS + is_global + IP pinning at save and at delivery; no redirects

attacks_that_held.result: Guard verifies every token before any decision

attacks_that_held.result: restricted content never reaches the model; forged fences defused
